text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ouuuch...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I messed up... I was certain I'd checked
my fortune
and the flow of qi.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Though, somehow the earth's voice feels
distant today...
owww!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no. It's fine! Something like this
won't prevent
me from spreading the
word of feng shui far and
wide!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's patch it up quickly and get back to
training!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Haha, there's no need to make that face,
Trainer!
I'm fine, so let's hurry back to
training!
choice_data_list: I can't let you push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're... right. Haha, sorry! I wasn't
really
thinking with a level head.
choice_data_list: Keeping yourself in peak condition is part of feng shui too, right?
Keeping yourself in peak condition is part of feng shui too, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I think I was so focused on what's in front
of me, I lost
sight of the bigger picture.
That could be why I couldn't
hear the
earth's voice.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, then. No more training for
today. I'm
going to properly focus on
resting and
recovering.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her calm front, I can tell that
she's feeling
down. It takes a long time
for Copano Rickey to
return to full
health.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course! If I pay attention to my luck,
I'll
definitely be fine! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Based on today's lucky direction, lucky
color, and
the affinity of the five
elements, I'd say the gym is
today's
lucky spot! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Right, then. Let's get back to training! I
can avoid
worsening my injury by
exercising parts of my
body one at a
time. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... nghh!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Th-this might be tougher than I
imagined... But, I
have to do my very
best so I can spread the word
of feng
shui...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. If I use feng shui to boost
my luck
and health, I'll be able to
recover in a flash.
choice_data_list: Let's focus on treatment after all.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'll do my best to properly
rest up and
recover as fast as I can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite what she says, she seems to be
feeling
down, and her recovery takes
longer than
expected.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff !

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! This is great! Coming to the
gym was
definitely a good idea!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm going to focus on weight
training
today to try and increase my
base strength!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to the positivity she gets
from
feng shui, Copano Rickey is able to
complete her
weight training without
worsening her injury.
